caption: Union coverage against distance moved. #208 fitted, and then refuted, a model in which diversity loss depends only on how far the policy travels. It does not hold here either: M-C crosses the 80% floor by KL 0.013, M-B around 0.016, and M-F not until 0.036 -- so per unit of KL the three rewards cost very different amounts of coverage. They differ in HOW they lose it (volume for M-C and M-F, redundancy for M-B) and in how fast, but not in WHETHER.
